_help: Act 7, Sir Reginald Blackwood (at the bank, after the artifacts are recovered, or when act7.gd decides): he wants the amulet for his collection. Refuse (blackwood_refused, the reward is forfeit), or confront him with the first expedition (needs clue_cairo_first_report or heard_blackwood_silence): he confesses and helps (blackwood_confessed, +100). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act67.py.

start.speaker: blackwood
start.line: So you're the man who found Akmentar. And brought back the one thing in it worth having. I'll take the amulet now, and the jars. You'll be paid, handsomely.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.line: No. They go back where they came from.

choices.label: Confront him
choices.line: Ashby's expedition found that door, didn't it? And you sent nobody after them.

choices.label: Confront him
choices.line: Your first expedition stopped answering, and you sent nobody after them. Until me.

choices.label: Explain the danger
choices.line: Look at the sky. That's what this amulet does when it's moved.

danger.speaker: blackwood
danger.line: Weather, dust, and superstition. I didn't build an empire by being frightened of the sky.

refuse.speaker: blackwood
refuse.line: Then you're a fool, and an unpaid one. Karim, see that Mr. ... see that he gets nothing. Not a penny.

confront.speaker: blackwood
confront.line: ...Ashby came back alone. Raving about a man in bronze bands who followed him to the camp. I paid his family and buried the report. I told myself it was heatstroke.

confess.speaker: blackwood
confess.line: Take it back. Take the money too. Karim, give him whatever he needs. I've been running from that report for two years.
